result.explanation: A pending offer expires at the start of each event, except advance first adds dt and then performs the expiration check. Matching accepts accumulate unique configured parties; the second party connects permanently until cancellation.
result.mapping: The state stores now, token, expires, approved, connected, and status. Each output is a snapshot plus whether expiration occurred during that event.
result.assumptions: Unknown operations and mismatched accepts/cancels are ignored with status ignored. Expiration clears only an unconnected pending session. Party IDs are ASCII as specified.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var p=input.config.parties,t=input.config.ttl,n=0,k=null,x=null,a=[],c=null,s='idle';for(var i=0;i<output.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],ex=false;if(e.type==='advance'){n+=e.dt;if(x!==null&&c===null&&n>=x){k=null;x=null;a=[];ex=true;s='expired'}}else if(x!==null&&c===null&&n>=x){k=null;x=null;a=[];ex=true;s='expired'}if(e.type==='offer'){k=e.token;x=n+t;a=[];c=null;s='offered'}else if(e.type==='accept'){if(c===null&&k===e.token&&p.indexOf(e.party)>=0){if(a.indexOf(e.party)>=0)s='duplicate';else{a.push(e.party);a.sort();if(a.length===2){c=k;x=null;s='connected'}else s='accepted'}}else if(!ex)s='ignored'}else if(e.type==='cancel'){if((c!==null||k!==null)&&e.token===k){k=null;x=null;a=[];c=null;s='cancelled'}else if(!ex)s='ignored'}else if(e.type==='advance')s='advanced';else if(e.type!=='offer'&&!ex)s='ignored';var q={status:s,now:n,token:k,expires:x,approved:a.slice().sort(),connected:c,expired:ex};if(JSON.stringify(q)!==JSON.stringify(output[i]))return false}return true}
